title: HyScale: Scaling Long-Context Training for Learned Sparse Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.32057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present HyScale, a long-context training system for learned sparse attention. Learned sparse attention is a promising architecture for million-token contexts, widely adopted in production since DeepSeek-V3.2. Selection, however, grows into the training bottleneck. For each query, it scores every previous token whereas sparse attention reads only $k$; worse, current systems materialize a full score table and repeat selection during recomputation. Our key insight is that the output of selection is not an activation, but rather a set of indices. Building on it, HyScale introduces HyTopK and selection replay. HyTopK finds each query's exact top-$k$ on the fly without a score table, while selection replay reuses forward-pass selection in recomputation. Together with holistic system optimizations tackling end-to-end training challenges, HyScale speeds up GLM-5.1 training on 1M-token sequences by 2.07$\times$ over Megatron-LM on 512 H20 GPUs

translated_title: HyScale：面向学习型稀疏注意力的长上下文训练扩展
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 HyScale，一个面向学习型稀疏注意力的长上下文训练系统。学习型稀疏注意力是一种适用于百万级词元上下文的有前景架构，自 DeepSeek-V3.2 以来已在生产环境中被广泛采用。然而，选择操作成为了训练瓶颈：对于每个查询，它需要对之前所有词元打分，而稀疏注意力只读取其中的 $k$ 个；更糟的是，当前系统会生成完整的分数表，并在重计算期间重复选择操作。我们的关键洞察是：选择的输出不是激活值，而是一组索引。基于这一洞察，HyScale 引入了 HyTopK 和选择重放机制。HyTopK 无需分数表即可实时找到每个查询的精确 top-$k$，而选择重放则在重计算中复用前向传播的选择结果。结合应对端到端训练挑战的整体系统优化，HyScale 在 512 块 H20 GPU 上将 GLM-5.1 在 1M 词元序列上的训练速度相比 Megatron-LM 提升了 2.07 倍。
tldr: HyScale 通过无需分数表的实时精确 top-k 选择方法和前向选择重放机制，将学习型稀疏注意力的百万词元长上下文训练速度提升了 2.07 倍。
en_tdlr: HyScale speeds up long-context training for learned sparse attention by 2.07x through HyTopK, which finds exact top-k selections on the fly without score tables, and selection replay, which reuses forward-pass selections during recomputation.
